inputs.text: The International Olympic Committee has done the right thing by banning transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and all future Games. Kirsty Coventry, the IOC president, stated it would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category. This decision upholds the basic fairness and biological reality that women's sports have always relied on, with clear separation by sex to maintain meaningful competition rooted in tradition. The usual progressive complaints calling this some exclusionary attack are just more nonsense that puts feelings over truth and harms actual women. Institutions must prioritize protecting the integrity of female categories and the natural distinctions tradition demands, rather than giving in to demands that erase them.
